content: BR course-platform economics: Kiwify around 7 percent plus R1 fixed per sale; Eduzz around 4.9 percent plus R2.49 direct sale, up to 8.9 percent via affiliate; none charge a separate member-area monthly fee. Hotmart has the largest affiliate marketplace, Kiwify simplest and fastest checkout (favored for low-ticket R47-197 offers), Eduzz stronger in health, finance and professional-dev niches via affiliates.
